_comment: Rules for questions that do not ask the patient anything — they only count how
other criteria were rated. The pipeline computes these instead of putting them
to the rater, which has no transcript to work from.
Each rule quotes the criterion text it encodes in `source`, so the arithmetic can
be checked against the SCID-5-CV booklet without reading any code.
Semantics of `at_least`: '+' when at least `n` of `of` are rated '+'. '-' when even
counting every unrated or '?' item as positive could not reach `n`. Otherwise '?'
and unresolved, naming the items that were not settled — the pipeline never asserts
a threshold over criteria it did not actually assess.
`n_if_irritable_only` records the DSM-5 clause that raises the threshold by one when
the mood was irritable but not elevated. `mood_quality_from` names the question that
establishes which it was: the rater records `mood_quality` ('elevated', 'irritable_only'
or 'unclear') on that question's response, and the threshold follows from it. If the
mood was never established, the lower threshold applies and a count that would change
under the higher one is flagged unresolved for clinician review rather than guessed at.

A10.label: At least five criteria met (Current MDE, Criterion A)
A10.source: AT LEAST FIVE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION A SXS (A1–A9) ARE RATED "+".

A24.label: Criterion A met (Past MDE)
A24.source: AT LEAST FIVE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION A SXS (A15–A23) ARE RATED "+".

A38.label: At least three Criterion B symptoms (Current Manic Episode)
A38.source: AT LEAST THREE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION B SXS (A31–A37) ARE RATED "+" (FOUR IF MOOD ONLY IRRITABLE).

A49.label: Criterion B threshold (Current Hypomanic Episode)
A49.source: AT LEAST THREE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION B SXS (A42–A48) ARE RATED "+" (FOUR IF MOOD ONLY IRRITABLE).

A63.label: Criterion B threshold met (Past Manic Episode)
A63.source: AT LEAST THREE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION B SXS (A56–A62) ARE RATED "+" (FOUR IF MOOD ONLY IRRITABLE).

A85.label: At least two Criterion B symptoms (Persistent Depressive Disorder)
A85.source: AT LEAST TWO OF THE ABOVE CRITERION B SXS (A79–A84) ARE RATED "+".

F51.label: At least three Criterion C symptoms (GAD)
F51.source: AT LEAST THREE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION C SXS (F45–F50) ARE RATED "+".

G5.label: Check for obsessions and/or compulsions
G5.source: PRESENCE OF OBSESSIONS (G2 RATED "+") OR COMPULSIONS (G4 RATED "+")

G19.label: PTSD Criterion B met (intrusion)
G19.source: AT LEAST ONE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION B SXS (G14–G18) IS RATED "+".

G22.label: PTSD Criterion C met (avoidance)
G22.source: AT LEAST ONE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION C SXS (G20-G21) IS RATED "+".

G30.label: PTSD Criterion D met (negative alterations in cognition and mood)
G30.source: AT LEAST TWO OF THE ABOVE CRITERION D SXS (G23–G29) ARE RATED "+".
G30.note: Criterion D has seven symptoms; only four were carried into questions.json. The count runs over the four that exist, so a patient positive on only the three missing items cannot be detected here.

G37.label: PTSD Criterion E met (alterations in arousal and reactivity)
G37.source: AT LEAST TWO OF THE ABOVE CRITERION E SXS (G31–G36) ARE RATED "+".

G41.label: PTSD diagnostic summary
G41.source: CRITERIA B (G19), C (G22), D (G30), and E (G37) ARE RATED "YES" FOR PAST MONTH AND CRITERION G (G39) (CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE) IS RATED "+" FOR PAST MONTH.
G41.note: All five must be '+'. The 'for past month' qualifier is not represented in session state; the timeframe is the interviewer's responsibility.

H11.label: Inattention Criterion A1 threshold
H11.source: AT LEAST FIVE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION A1 (INATTENTION) SXS (H2–H10) ARE RATED "+".

H21.label: ADHD Criterion A2 threshold (hyperactivity-impulsivity)
H21.source: AT LEAST FIVE OF THE ABOVE CRITERION A2 (HYPERACTIVITY-IMPULSIVITY) SXS (H12–H20) ARE RATED "+".

H22.label: Combined Criterion A1 or A2 check
H22.source: AT LEAST FIVE SXS IN CRITERION A1 (H11) OR CRITERION A2 (H21) ARE RATED "+".
